seat.office: Prime Minister of the Fridge (leader of the Fresh Food majority on the middle shelf)

above.name: The Householder (the hand that opens the door)
above.power: Dismiss: can bin any member, the Prime Minister included, at any time, and decides the weekly shop that restocks the chamber

above.name: The Expiry Date
above.power: Term limit: a member past its date is removed from office and eligibility

plan.grounding_line: Grounded in the fridge's own logic (shelf life, expiry dates, spoilage, temperature zones, the weekly shop) played straight through Westminster-style parliamentary patterns by analogy

roster.grounding_line: The Parliament of the Fridge follows the fridge's own logic of shelf life, expiry dates, spoilage, temperature zones and the weekly shop, and runs it through Westminster patterns: a Prime Minister who must keep a majority on the Middle Shelf, an opposition in the Crisper Drawer, a Householder who reigns and can bin any member, and an Expiry Date that works as a hard term limit.

ruler.office: Prime Minister of the Fridge (leader of the Fresh Food majority on the Middle Shelf)
ruler.removed_by: The Householder can bin you at any time and decides the weekly shop that restocks the chamber; the Expiry Date removes you the day you pass your date; the Parliament of the Fridge can vote you out if the Fresh Food majority breaks.

groups.name: The Frigidaire Householder
groups.sits_where: the Kitchen, beyond the Frigidaire Door
groups.support_why: The hand that opens the door keeps a fresh majority while it is still being eaten, but its patience ends at the first smell.
groups.wants: A fridge that stays clean, cold and fully eaten before the weekly shop, with nothing thrown away.

groups.name: The FDA Expiry Date
groups.quote: A term limit is a nomination rule which restricts the number of terms a person may run for and serve in a particular elected office.
groups.support_why: The printed date treats every member alike and bends for no Prime Minister, however fresh the government looks on day one.
groups.wants: Strict enforcement of use-by dates, with no member kept past its stamp by freezing or relabelling.

groups.name: The Perkins Fresh Food Party
groups.quote: The head of government, usually called the prime minister or premier, will ideally have the support of a majority in the responsible house
groups.support_why: The milk, meats and cheeses of the Middle Shelf chose this Prime Minister as their leader and hold a majority of four.
groups.wants: First claim on the coldest space, eating order ahead of the other shelves, and a weekly shop that restocks fresh food first.

groups.name: The Cullen Crisper Drawer Vegetables
groups.quote: Fresh fruits and vegetables, especially salds crops, which contain living cells that respire even while refrigerated.
groups.support_why: The Official Opposition wilts out of sight at the bottom of the fridge and blames the Middle Shelf government for its neglect.
groups.wants: Humidity control, a place in the Householder's eye line and vegetables eaten before the meat.

groups.name: The Linde Freezer Bloc
groups.quote: According to the USDA, "Frozen foods remain safe indefinitely".
groups.support_why: The frozen peas and ice cream outlast every government, stay out of shelf quarrels and back whoever leaves them unthawed.
groups.wants: No defrosting, no power cuts and recognition that frozen members sit outside the Expiry Date.

groups.name: The Nave Door Shelf Condiments
groups.quote: A cooling zone in the refrigerator door shelves.
groups.support_why: The long-lived jars of mustard, ketchup and pickles are crossbenchers who have seen many governments and prefer a steady one.
groups.wants: Their places on the door kept and no clear-out of half-empty jars.

groups.name: The Tupperware Leftovers
groups.quote: Leftovers from meals at home are often eaten later.
groups.sits_where: a sealed box at the front of the Top Shelf
groups.support_why: Last night's dinner holds a single seat, lives on borrowed days and will trade its vote for a promise to be eaten next.
groups.wants: To be eaten tomorrow at lunch rather than pushed to the back and forgotten.

groups.name: The Penicillium Mould
groups.quote: Fungi, primarily molds, are a cause of food spoilage and create the characteristic visual signs of spoilage.
groups.sits_where: the back corner of the Bottom Shelf
groups.support_why: The mould spreads by occupying forgotten members, and a government that keeps the fridge eaten and clean starves it of ground.
groups.wants: Warm, humid, neglected corners and members left well past their dates.

groups.name: The Clostridium Botulinum
groups.quote: For example, Clostridium botulinum spoils food such as meat and poultry.
groups.sits_where: inside sealed and airless members of the Middle Shelf
groups.support_why: The bacterium works unseen inside the governing party's own meat, and it has no interest in any government that chills it.
groups.wants: Airless, underheated members and a government too distracted to notice poisoning without a smell.

groups.name: The Appert Pantry Canned Goods
groups.quote: most "canned foods are safe indefinitely as long as they are not exposed to freezing temperatures
groups.support_why: The shelf-stable neighbour competes for the same weekly shop and gains whenever fresh food spoils.
groups.wants: A bigger share of the weekly shop spent on tins rather than on the fresh food of the Middle Shelf.

groups.name: The contents of the Fridge
groups.quote: A refrigerator maintains a temperature a few degrees above the freezing point of water.
groups.sits_where: every shelf, drawer and door of the Fridge
groups.support_why: The eggs, butter and loose items judge the new government by one thing, whether the door stays shut and the cold holds.
groups.wants: Steady cold, a closed door and a fair order of eating.
